final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) as count_active FROM customer WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY store_id), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(count_active) as total_active FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT store_id, count_active, count_active*1.0/total_active as proportion FROM step1, step2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step3) SELECT step3.store_id, step3.count_active, step3.proportion, step3.proportion/step4.avg_proportion as normalized_ratio FROM step3, step4
